exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs Vaginal delivery)
cohort: Postnatal mothers at two hospitals in Nigeria
finding: Mode of delivery does not affect time to resumption of coitus after childbirth, and FSF disorders by 3 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with shorter time to first coitus at 6 weeks postpartum but not at 3 months, and higher FSFI domain scores for orgasm, satisfaction, and pain at 6 weeks postpartum but not at 3 months.
